# Generated files carry the full generated header

Decided on 2026-10-18. It replaces the first point of
"no-generated-code-header-and-no-package-named-generated".

- Every file `go generate ./...` writes opens with the generated header
  of REQ-1117: `Code generated by tools/ci generate. DO NOT EDIT.`, the
  source, and the command `go generate ./...`, as mockgen's header does.
- The linters read generated files; the checks that skip one on their
  own are named and accepted in ADR 0016.
- ADR 0016 records it.
